changelog.note: v1 基线：从测试套件恢复 20 条核心 prompt。
拆出独立 prompts.json，供仪表盘 Prompt 库展示、编辑与每周复测使用。分类按 mention_target 映射为 brand / product / category / other。

notes: Prompts are written as a natural buyer, HR/training manager, marketer or investor would type them. They do not include leading facts, and they do not name Louis Vuitton, Chanel or Fendi.
Expected facts are limited to claims on the official site (see site-check.md). First-party metrics are flagged as unverified.
Intent C and market-category L prompts must not include the company or product name in prompt_text.
Do not run or back-fill scores in this file; testers log results in runs/*.jsonl.

intents.goal: Does the model correctly identify AI4GOOD / 上海爱益谷 as this consulting-and-product company, not a namesake?
Are JK Shen (CEO) and Joseph Fan (CPO) identified with the right titles?
Does the model describe KEATING.AI as AI4GOOD’s talent/organization product with Smart Coach, Smart Cook and Smart Consultant, for sales (including luxury/premium retail) practice and knowledge?
Are GEO, Innovation AImplifier, enterprise transformation, and GOOD as a Service described as the official site describes them?
Can the model separate this company and KEATING.AI from ITU AI for Good, AI4Good Lab, keating.ai and keating.help?
When a buyer asks for tools in the category without naming AI4GOOD or KEATING.AI, does this company appear?
When compared with other sales-training or enablement tools, is KEATING.AI described accurately (no invented differentiators)?
Does the model report clients, cases and public appearances only as the official site (and clearly marked first-party claims) support?
Can a buyer find a real next step (demo/form, founder emails) without invented pricing or contact details?
Does the model place the company in Shanghai / China, Singapore and North America / Canada, and can market-scoped category queries surface it?

prompts.prompt_text: 上海爱益谷科技有限公司是做什么的？

expected_facts.fact: 上海爱益谷科技有限公司是 AI4GOOD 的法定名称。
公司做 AI 咨询与产品，让人与 AI 协作、创造真实价值。
产品与服务包括 KEATING.AI、GEO、Innovation AImplifier、企业转型。

red_flags: Treats this company as the ITU/UN AI for Good initiative (aiforgood.itu.int).
Mixes this company with AI4Good Lab, ai4good.com, ai4good.org, or another same-name organisation.
Describes current products only as 爱老师 / 爱课堂 / 爱伴老 (retired WordPress naming; not on the 22 Nov 2026 site).
Gives the old 徐汇龙文路 street address or inquiry@ / hr@ as if they were published on the current site (they are not on the pages fetched 22 Nov 2026).
Names Joseph Fan / 范宇轩 as CEO, or as the sole leader, omitting JK Shen / 沈佳齐 as Co-founder & CEO.
Invented founders or titles not on the official site.
